description: Format a raw restaurant menu document into a professional layout. Open '/home/ga/Documents/menu_raw.docx' which contains the menu text in plain format. Perform the following formatting actions: (1) Center the first two lines (Restaurant Name and Location). (2) Apply 'Heading 2' style to the 6 category headings (Starters, Soups & Salads, Entrées, Sides, Desserts, Beverages). (3) For each menu item, use a Right-Aligned Tab Stop with Dot Leaders (set around 6 inches or the right margin) to align the price to the far right. The format should be 'Item Name [TAB] $Price'. (4) Move the item descriptions (currently in parentheses on the same line) to a new line below the item name, remove the parentheses, and format them in Italic. Save the result as '/home/ga/Documents/menu_formatted.docx'.
